The primary operational bottleneck identified in the text is the inefficient layout of the central tool and material repository. Because the repository is located in a single central point, workers must travel significant distances across the work site to retrieve items. This results in lost productivity due to the time spent commuting back and forth between the repository and various construction areas.

To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing the storage of tools and materials. Implementing satellite storage units or mobile tool carts closer to active construction zones would reduce travel time, minimize downtime, and allow workers to focus more on their primary tasks.

Regarding the priority question: The primary material of a candle is wax.
